ValidationRule.description: For users in the Help Desk to update only categories under the Help Desk functional group. Will give an error if attempting to edit: a. A Sub-category b. A Functional Group c. A Category not under the Help Desk functional group
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND($Profile.Name ='ASU Service - Help Desk', OR(RecordType.DeveloperName ='Functional_Group',
AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Category', Parent__r.Name <>'Help Desk'),
ISCHANGED(Name),
RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Sub_Category' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Users with the profile of ASU Service - Help Desk can only edit Case Classification values for categories under the Functional Group "Help Desk"
